data.research_question: What official committee/location evidence advances the GOP common-recipient depth-4 target, and what current material news updates the existing GOP funding network without overstating transactions?
data.method: Enumerated 27 physical digs roots on current main. Excluded free-range (meta) and the previous three successful hourly roots dnc, cloarida, and greater-israel, leaving 23 eligible roots:canada-policy-influence, cia, dark-academia, devil-corp, drunk-drivers, fed, flock, gop, graphika, hunter-biden, larry-fink, lexisnexis-risk-state-surveillance, occrp-aleph, offshore-leaks, palantir, tech-bro, trump-netanyahu, trump-thiel-circle, us-israel-military-integration, usaid-doge-mortality-accountability, violent-offenders, wef, wef-columbus. Dataset seed 4688419144861733889 from SHA-256(main|2026-08-18T11:00:00Z|hourly-auto-dig|dataset-first-v1) selected gop uniformly at the dataset stage. The deepest explicit current GOP recursion surfaced two queued depth-4 targets:starintel:investigation-target:gop-fec-amendment-delta-depth-4 and starintel:investigation-target:gop-recipient-overlap-jfc-depth-4. Target seed 2645826833755139962 selected starintel:investigation-target:gop-recipient-overlap-jfc-depth-4. The exact whole-corpus actionable-target total was not fabricated because connector code search does not reproduce Free-Range's complete DB+packet terminal-state, blocker, deduplication, and discovered-candidate semantics. Within the selected target's seed frontier, C00096412 was chosen for a coherent incremental organization/location slice because its normalized organization lacked location_ids and FEC provides an exact current public committee mailing address plus principal-campaign-committee classification. Current-news review after location enrichment found Axios August 13 reporting about expected future RNC and MAGA Inc. midterm spending; it is ingested only as an attributed claim, not as proof that any disbursement occurred.
classification_rules: dataset-first sampling with last-three hourly anti-repeat exclusions
public committee mailing address is not headquarters or candidate residence
official FEC identifiers support exact committee-to-candidate classification
reported expectation of future spending is not an executed transaction

findings.finding: FEC identifies FRIENDS OF CHRIS SMITH (C00096412) as a House principal campaign committee authorized by Christopher H. Smith (H8NJ04014).
FEC publishes PO Box 1266, Toms River, NJ 08754-1266 as the committee mailing address; no headquarters or candidate-residence claim is made.
Axios reports an expectation that RNC and MAGA Inc. money will enter midterm races, but reviewed reporting does not specify when or where and does not establish an executed RNC disbursement.
The exact transactions that made C00096412 part of the common-recipient overlap seed set remain unresolved in this bounded pass.
